meta.title: Open Calc Studio — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Open Calc Studio: free, open source budgeting and cost estimating software for construction. From cost estimate to final account, with STABU/RAW, FIEBDC-3, IFC quantities and an AI assistant. For Windows, macOS, Linux and the browser.

header.label: Budgeting and estimating
header.title: Open Calc Studio
header.tagline: From cost estimate to final account
header.desc: Open-source budgeting and cost estimation tool for construction. From cost estimates to final accounts, with direct connections to STABU/RAW, FIEBDC-3 (.bc3), IFCX and AI — in 40 languages.

notice.text: Public testing: Open Calc Studio is usable, but not yet signed off for production work. Check your budgets and report what is wrong on GitHub.

features.label: Features
features.heading: Everything for a sound budget
features.sub: Start with the highlights or pick a topic.

budget.title: A budget you can read at a glance
budget.desc: Chapters, items and lines in one grid, with STABU and RAW structure, variants and workspaces for measuring, budgeting and checking.

reports.title: A report for every stage
reports.desc: From quotation and tender list to work description and final costing: nine report types, as PDF in the report language you choose.

summary.title: Cost and mark-ups in one overview
summary.desc: The cost per chapter, the mark-ups and the contract sum, always up to date with the budget.

assistant.title: Ask the estimating assistant
assistant.desc: Describe the work or the change; the assistant proposes what changes in the budget, and you decide whether it is applied.

stabu.title: STABU/RAW integration
stabu.desc: Full support for STABU and RAW standards for standardized specifications and cost estimates according to Dutch norms.

chapters.title: Chapters & sections
chapters.desc: Organize budgets into chapters, sections and budget items. Flexible hierarchy with automatic numbering.

staart.title: Overhead costs
staart.desc: Configurable overhead costs: general site costs, profit & risk, CAR insurance and other surcharges automatically calculated.

recalc.title: Recalculation
recalc.desc: One-click recalculation of the entire budget. All subtotals, VAT and overhead costs are automatically updated.

btw.title: High and low VAT
btw.desc: Choose the VAT rate per chapter, item or line. Subtotals and the grand total automatically use the right rate.

reference.title: Reference projects
reference.desc: Look up unit prices from reference projects. Build a reusable database of prices and key figures.

ifcx.title: IFCX quantities
ifcx.desc: Automatically extract quantities from IFCX models. Link budget items directly to model elements for accurate calculations.

export.title: PDF & IFCX export
export.desc: Export budgets as professional PDF reports or as IFCX data for exchange with other tools in the ecosystem.

bc3.title: FIEBDC-3 (.bc3)
bc3.desc: Import and export the Spanish exchange format FIEBDC-3, common across the Spanish construction sector — proven loss-free for amounts and structure.

onorm.title: ÖNORM A 2063 (.onlv)
onorm.desc: Read Austrian Leistungsverzeichnisse and Leistungsbücher and export as .onlv, validated against the official XML schemas.

mcp.title: MCP Server
mcp.desc: Fully accessible via Model Context Protocol. AI assistants can create, edit and export budgets.

extensions.title: Extension system
extensions.desc: Extensible via an extension catalog. Add industry-specific calculation methods, templates and integrations.

talen.title: 40 languages
talen.desc: Full interface translation in 40 languages, including right-to-left for Arabic, Farsi, Hebrew and Urdu. English is the default; pick your language via Preferences → General.

rapporttaal.title: Reports in your own language
rapporttaal.desc: Printing and PDF reports follow the separate Report language setting: headings, units and number and date formatting (1.234,56 € in Spanish, € 1,234.56 in English).

laptop.title: Small laptop screens
laptop.desc: Compact header, collapsible sidebar, a scrollable ribbon and fitting dialogs.

cost.a: Nothing. Open Calc Studio is open source under the LGPL-3.0: no licence fees and no account needed.

ready.q: Can I make real budgets with it yet?
ready.a: Open Calc Studio is in public testing. You can work with it fully, but check the results and report errors on GitHub. Projects are saved in the open .ifcCalc format.

files.a: Next to its own .ifcCalc format the app reads FIEBDC-3 (.bc3), ÖNORM A 2063 (.onlv), Excel budgets with column mapping and IFC models for quantities.

browser.q: Do I have to install anything?
browser.a: No, the app also runs in the browser. The desktop version for Windows, macOS and Linux also has the local MCP server and REST API for AI assistants and your own scripts.

platforms.q: Does it run on a Mac and on Linux?
platforms.a: Yes. There is a universal .dmg for Macs with Apple silicon and Intel, and for Linux an AppImage, .deb, .rpm and Snap. On Windows you pick the .exe or, for administrators, the .msi.

ai.q: What can an AI assistant do with it?
ai.a: Through MCP an assistant creates budgets, adds lines, recalculates and exports to PDF or IFC. In the app itself, the estimating assistant proposes changes that you review first.

tech.heading: Technology
tech.sub: For those who want to know how it is built.

tauri.title: TypeScript, Rust and Tauri 2
tauri.desc: One code base for the desktop and the browser.

mcp.title: MCP server and REST API
mcp.desc: Local on 127.0.0.1, for AI assistants and your own scripts.

embed.title: Embed package and SDK
embed.desc: A React package to put the app in your own site, plus a headless API and a native Windows library.

format.title: Open .ifcCalc format
format.desc: Projects in an open format based on IFC, with quantities that trace back to their source.

bc3.title: Tested on real files: FIEBDC-3 (.bc3)
bc3.desc: We imported 22 real .bc3 budgets, exported them and imported them again — including the Andalusian cost database BCCA 2023 with 46,215 rows.
bc3.item1: All amounts and chapter totals identical after the round trip (± 0.01)
bc3.item2: 21 of the 22 files identical field by field; in 1 file only a duplicate chapter code gets a suffix
bc3.item3: Every bug found in the importer and exporter fixed; the test runs in the test suite
